title: Toggle Visibility
instructions: Create a button that toggles showing/hiding a message using {#if}.
starterCode:
<script>
  let visible = $state(true);
</script>

<button onclick={() => visible = !visible}>
  {visible ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}
</button>

<!-- Add an {#if} block to show/hide the message -->
solution:
{#if visible}

Now you see me!

{:else}

Now you don't!

{/if}
